g.text: Displays a dialog box with a message, set of buttons, and optional title, help file, and context information, and returns the user's selection as a
result = MsgBox(prompt[, buttons][, title][, helpfile][, context])
: The message text displayed in the dialog box.
enumeration that specifies the buttons, icon style, default button, and modality of the message box.
: (Optional) The title bar text. If omitted, the application name is used.
: (Optional) The path to a help file for context-sensitive help.
: (Optional) The help context number associated with the help file.
, [ByVal Buttons As VbMsgBoxStyle = vbOKOnly], [ByRef Title As Variant], [ByRef HelpFile As Variant], [ByRef Context As Variant]) As VbMsgBoxResult
